facts.fact: The Right to Access Information Commission's open data page lists the Right to Access Information Act 2013 among its documents, and its sibling policy document quotes the Act as giving every person the right to access information held by a public authority.

The page, dated 18 January 2017, describes the Right to Access Information Commission as in operation, coordinating the open data programme, chairing a 60-member Open Data Council and providing overall management of the open data portal.
